requirements.requirement: The system must transform raw prescription behavior input into a structured UI model that conforms exactly to the TypeScript schema defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must normalize prescribing pattern values (e.g., counts, rates, percentages) into a consistent numeric format suitable for UI display.
The system must map condition identifiers or codes from input data to human-readable condition labels using a deterministic mapping.
The system must calculate the relative contribution of prescription behavior to the overall provider quality score as a percentage value.
The system must ensure that calculated contribution percentages are bounded between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The system must produce display-ready data structures that require no additional transformation by the MessageBubble rendering component.
The system must preserve ordering of prescribing patterns based on descending significance or contribution for UI display.
The system must handle missing prescribing pattern fields by substituting safe default values without throwing runtime errors.
The system must return an empty but valid UI structure when prescription behavior input data is null or empty.
The system must exclude invalid or non-numeric values from normalization calculations and log or flag them without breaking execution.
The system must ensure that all output fields required by the UI schema are populated or explicitly set to null.
The system must perform all transformations deterministically such that identical inputs always produce identical outputs.
The system must complete transformation processing within a time threshold suitable for synchronous UI rendering (<=100ms for typical payload).
The system must support multiple prescribing patterns in a single input payload and aggregate them into a single display-ready structure.
